free_tier.stated: 200,000 credits a month for development and evaluation, with standard basemaps and basic APIs only; Autocomplete Search (v2) costs 1 credit a request and Standard Routing 20 credits a request, while Forward Geocoding, Reverse Geocoding and Bulk Geocoding are not on the Free plan; a hard limit with HTTP 429 when the month's credits run out
free_tier.notes: every new account first gets a 14-day Professional trial with the same 200,000-credit limit and stays on Free after it; Starter, USD 20 a month, gives 1,000,000 credits with basic and standard geocoding APIs

per_object_cap.stated: Bulk Geocoding takes up to 5,000 queries a request, on Standard, Professional and Enterprise plans only; a standard route takes up to 50 locations

retention.stated: temporary storage in the normal course of work is allowed on Free; permanently storing geocoding results needs an active Standard, Professional or Enterprise subscription

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in credits, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS to api.stadiamaps.com (for example /geocoding/v2/autocomplete and /route/v1) with the key in an api_key query parameter or an Authorization: Stadia-Auth header
tooling: any HTTP client; official SDKs and an OpenAPI specification at api.stadiamaps.com/openapi.yaml
chaining: 200,000 credits a month, spent at 1 credit an autocomplete lookup or 20 credits a standard route; results are kept only temporarily on Free, and Bulk Geocoding needs a paid Standard plan, so the Free plan has no bulk path

limits.value: 200,000 credits a month on the Free plan, hard-limited with HTTP 429 when used up
no fixed requests-per-second limit for registered API keys; rate limits for abusive or disruptive use and for keyless local development
geocoding results only stored temporarily on Free; permanent storage needs Standard, Professional or Enterprise
Bulk Geocoding up to 5,000 queries a request, on Standard, Professional and Enterprise only

binding_note: registered keys have no fixed request rate, so the monthly 200,000-credit pool is the first limit met

identity_cost.detail: an account at client.stadiamaps.com with an email and a password (first and last name fields optional) behind an hCaptcha check; no credit card for the trial or the Free plan

reliability_note: when the month's credits are used up every API answers HTTP 429 until the next calendar month; proxying or bulk downloading and caching bring escalating de-prioritization and then a rate limit
confidence_note: the pricing page, the limits docs, the FAQ, the storage article, the terms, the geocoding, routing and autocomplete docs, the routing product page and the raw sign-up form were quoted on 2026-10-31; a keyless search answered HTTP 401. No account was opened, so no keyed request was made; one would move it to measured.
